name: DiscountPilot – Dynamic Pricing & Discount Rules for WooCommerce
author: arsyntax

sections.description:
DiscountPilot is your ultimate dynamic pricing solution for WooCommerce. Create complex and high-converting discount rules for your store with ease. From simple percentage discounts to advanced bulk discount tiers and BOGO deals, DiscountPilot gives you full control over your store’s pricing strategy. Manage category discounts, coupon automation, and dynamic pricing rules all in one powerful plugin.

🚀 Key Benefits:

  • Boost Sales with Discount Rules: Encourage customers to buy more with strategic bulk discount and bundle discount tactics.
  • Increase Average Order Value (AOV): Reward loyal customers with personalized dynamic pricing and category discounts.
  • Smart Discount Conditions: Apply discount rules only when specific conditions are met (cart total, customer role, etc.).
  • Automated Coupon Marketing: Auto-apply coupon codes and create URL-based promotional strategies.

Free Features

  • Simple Discounts with Dynamic Pricing: Apply fixed amount or percentage discounts to products with full dynamic pricing control.
  • Bundle Discounts & Bulk Discount Options: Set special prices for specific quantities using bulk discount strategies (e.g., 3 for $50 or Buy 3 items for 10% off).
  • Buy X Get X (BOGO) Deals: Buy a quantity of a product and get a discount on the same product with this classic discount rule structure (e.g., Buy One Get One Free).
  • Buy X Get Y Cross-Sell Discounts: Buy a specific product and receive a discount on a different product—perfect for category discount campaigns.
  • Dynamic Product Filtering with Category Discount Support: Filter products by Categories, Brands, Variations, Attributes, Featured status, On-sale status, and Trending status (sold in last 15 days). Apply category discount rules to specific product groups.
  • Advanced Product Properties Filter: Filter by Regular Price, Stock Quantity, or Custom Meta Fields for targeted discount rules.
  • Basic Cart Conditions for Bulk Discount Logic:
    • Cart total weight
    • Number of cart items
    • Subtotal (including tax)
  • Cart & Coupon Discounts: Create custom coupon codes with fixed or percentage discounts. Manage multiple coupon strategies with flexible discount rules.
  • Date & Time Scheduling: Schedule your discount rules and category discount campaigns with precise start and end dates.
  • Display Settings: Toggle discount tables and custom messages on single product pages using dynamic pricing templates.
  • Custom Messages: Display custom messages when a bulk discount, category discount, or any discount rule is applied.

Pro Features

Upgrade to the Pro version for advanced automation and even more powerful dynamic pricing and discount rule strategies:

  • Bulk / Tiered Pricing with Advanced Discount Rules: Create complex quantity-based bulk discount pricing tables (e.g., 1-5 items: 5% off, 6-10 items: 10% off, 11+ items: 20% off). Perfect for bulk discount campaigns and dynamic pricing strategies.
  • Auto-Apply Coupon Codes: Automatically apply coupon codes to the cart when discount rule conditions are met with intelligent coupon automation.
  • URL Coupons for Dynamic Pricing: Generate coupon links that automatically apply discounts when visited (e.g., yoursite.com/cart/?coupon=code) for easy discount rule distribution.
  • Coupon Usage Limits: Set total usage limits and per-user limits for your coupon codes and discount rules.
  • Advanced Cart Conditions for Bulk Discount & Dynamic Pricing:
    • Subtotal excluding tax
    • Quantity of specific items/categories/brands in cart
    • Subtotal of specific items/categories/brands (inc/ex tax)
    • Coupon codes already applied in cart
    • Max dimensions (width/height/length) of cart items
    • Minimum stock quantity of cart items
    • Shipping classes in cart
  • Customer-Specific Discounts with Category Discount Support:
    • User Roles (Wholesale, VIP, etc.)
    • User Capabilities
    • Specific Email addresses
    • Login status
    • User Meta fields for personalized discount rules
  • Customer Value Conditions for Dynamic Pricing:
    • Total money spent by customer
    • Number of previous orders
    • Last order amount and date
    • Average money spent per order
    • Number of product reviews submitted
  • Purchase History Rules with Bulk Discount Application:
    • History of bought specific products, variations, categories, or brands using category discount logic.
    • Quantity and amount of money spent on specific categories/brands in the past for targeted discount rules.
  • Checkout & Shipping Conditions:
    • Payment method (e.g., discount for Cash on Delivery)
    • Shipping method
    • Shipping address (Country, State, City, Postcode, Zone)

Discount Modes

  1. Simple: Apply a direct discount to products using basic dynamic pricing and discount rules.
  2. Bulk (PRO): Create tiered bulk discount pricing based on purchase quantity ranges with advanced dynamic pricing.
  3. Bundle: Apply bundle discounts and category discount strategies when a specific number of items are bundled together. Supports fixed bundle price, fixed item price, and percentage/fixed discounts.
  4. Buy X Get X: Traditional BOGO deals with classic discount rules where the free/discounted item is the same as the purchased item.
  5. Buy X Get Y: Upsell or cross-sell by offering a category discount or special dynamic pricing on Product Y when Product X is purchased.

Conditions & Comparison

You can combine multiple discount rules using AND/OR logic groups. Build sophisticated discount rule structures with our bulk discount and category discount tools. Supported comparison operators include:
* Less than / Less equal to
* Greater than / Greater equal to
* Equal to / Not equal to
* In / Not in (for lists like categories or products)
* Yes / No (for boolean checks)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/discountpilot-dynamic-pricing directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to DiscountPilot menu in your WordPress admin dashboard to start creating your first discount rule, bulk discount strategy, or category discount campaign.
sections.faq:
How do I add a discount rule?

Navigate to the DiscountPilot menu, click “Add New” in the Pricing Discounts section, choose your discount mode (simple, bulk discount, bundle, BOGO, or category discount), and set your rules and conditions for dynamic pricing.

Can I apply multiple discount rules to the same product?

Yes! The plugin evaluates discount rules in order. You can set up multiple discount rules, bulk discount strategies, and category discount campaigns that will be applied according to the logic defined in your settings.

Does it work with variable products and category discounts?

Yes! You can target specific variations, entire categories (category discount), or apply discount rules to all variations of a product. Create sophisticated bulk discount and dynamic pricing strategies for your product catalog.

How do I create bulk discount tiers?

In the Pro version, select the “Bulk (PRO)” discount mode, and you’ll be able to create complex tiered bulk discount pricing tables based on purchase quantities.

Can I create coupon codes automatically?

Yes! In the Pro version, you can use the Auto-Apply Coupon feature to automatically apply coupon codes when your discount rule conditions are met.
